title: All Devices assignments carry many exclusions

maxExclusions.text: Exclusions above which the intent is no longer visible

report.title: {Items.Count} broad {Plural(Items.Count, 'assignment has', 'assignments have')} more than {params.maxExclusions} exclusions

messages.businessImpact: Nobody can tell what the assignment actually covers without working through the exclusion list, so mistakes are found by their effects rather than by review.
remediation: Replace the broad assignment plus exclusions with an inclusion group, or with a filter that expresses the intent directly.
messages.cannotSee: An exclusion is counted, not judged: a broad assignment carved back to the right population with exclusions is a legitimate way to work and reads here the same as one nobody has maintained. The count is of assignments rather than of people, so one exclusion of a large group counts once and twenty exclusions of empty ones count twenty. Nothing is read about whether the excluded groups still exist or still hold anyone, which is HYG-006's question.
